address_pairs.kinship: older brother addressing his younger brother and Crown Prince
address_pairs.notes: The Emperor uses this familiar name while recounting Zhu Bao’s request.
address_pairs.speaker: 황제

address_pairs.notes: Taekyung uses 노야 while jokingly asking whether Jeok Cheongang intends to strike the Emperor himself.
address_pairs.speaker: 진태경

continuity: The Emperor has ordered that the purge distinguish the guilty from the innocent, honoring Crown Prince Zhu Bao’s request to spare those uninvolved in the treason.
The Bow Saint identifies Taekyung as the Martial God’s chosen one and says his present irrecoverable state contradicts the powers he was supposed to possess.
plot: Baek Yeon orders the arrest of the treasonous officials. Taekyung worries that innocent people may be caught in the purge, and the Emperor says he will honor Zhu Bao’s request to establish each person’s guilt and spare the innocent.

The Bow Saint leads Taekyung to a secluded garden and identifies him as the chosen one mentioned by the Martial God. She says he should have possessed powers to escape even death, then asks why he is in an irrecoverable state.
translation_decisions: Render 황태제 as “Crown Prince” in this succession context.
Use “Old Master” for 노야 when Taekyung addresses Jeok Cheongang.

active_continuity: Zhu Bao is Crown Prince; the Emperor is his older brother and supports his compassionate vision of rulership.
The Emperor has ordered a purge of treason suspects while promising to spare the innocent after their connections are established.
The Bow Saint says Taekyung is the chosen one mentioned by the Martial God, yet is in an irrecoverable state despite supposedly having powers to escape death.
open_questions: Why is Taekyung in an irrecoverable state, and what powers was he supposed to possess as the Martial God’s chosen one?
What story has So Gyo kept to herself?
Where is Ma Sanbao, and what is his current status?
What did Wei Zhong tell Taekyung through Sound Transmission?
Will the Salcheonmun pursue Mungyeong or discover that Taekyung killed Gye Yabu?
temporary_decisions: Keep “Force” for 강기 distinct from “death energy” for 사기.
Render 황태제 as “Crown Prince” in this succession context.
